name: ensureSessions
create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_username ON sessions(username)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_expiry ON sessions(expires_at)

name: ensureAppts
create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS appointments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT, phone TEXT, service TEXT, vehicle TEXT, pref_date TEXT, alt_date TEXT, daytime TEXT, vin TEXT, msg TEXT, lang TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'appointment', status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new', created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS appointment_events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, appointment_id INTEGER NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, by_user TEXT, note TEXT, at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_appts_status ON appointments(status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_appt_events_aid ON appointment_events(appointment_id)

name: ensureMaint
create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS maintenance (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, vehicle TEXT NOT NULL, service TEXT NOT NULL, due_date TEXT, note TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by TEXT)
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_maint_public ON maintenance(public_active)

name: ensureFleetBlocks
create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fleet_blocks (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, vehicle TEXT NOT NULL, from_dt TEXT NOT NULL, to_dt TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT, created_by TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fleet_blocks_veh ON fleet_blocks(vehicle)

name: ensureApptBlocks
create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS appointment_blocks (date TEXT NOT NULL, slot TEXT NOT NULL, note TEXT, created_by TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (date, slot))

name: ensureRentalInspections
create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rental_inspections (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, booking_id INTEGER NOT NULL, stage TEXT NOT NULL, inspected_at TEXT NOT NULL, odometer INTEGER, fuel_level TEXT, condition_note TEXT, damage_note TEXT, photo_refs TEXT, accessories TEXT, license_checked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, deposit_amount REAL, extra_km INTEGER, extra_costs REAL, customer_signature TEXT, staff_signature TEXT, note TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by TEXT, UNIQUE(booking_id, stage))
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_inspections_booking ON rental_inspections(booking_id)

name: requestConsents
create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS request_consents (request_type TEXT NOT NULL, request_id INTEGER NOT NULL, privacy_accepted INTEGER NOT NULL, terms_accepted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, privacy_version TEXT, terms_version TEXT, consent_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (request_type, request_id))

name: rateLimits
create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS booking_rate_limits (bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY, count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rate_limits_expiry ON booking_rate_limits(expires_at)

name: ensureCustomers
create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT, phone TEXT, notes TEXT, source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_vehicles (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, make_model TEXT NOT NULL, plate TEXT, vin TEXT, year TEXT, mileage INTEGER, notes TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_customers_email ON customers(email)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_customers_phone ON customers(phone)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_customer_vehicles_customer ON customer_vehicles(customer_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_customer_vehicles_plate ON customer_vehicles(plate)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_customer_vehicles_vin ON customer_vehicles(vin)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_customers_email_norm ON customers(lower(trim(email)))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_appointments_email_norm ON appointments(lower(trim(email)))

name: ensureWorkOrders
create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS work_orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, appointment_id INTEGER, customer_id INTEGER, vehicle_id INTEGER, reference TEXT, title TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned', assigned_to TEXT, planned_minutes INTEGER, description TEXT, diagnosis TEXT, internal_note TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS work_order_events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, work_order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, by_user TEXT, note TEXT, at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_work_orders_appointment ON work_orders(appointment_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_work_orders_status ON work_orders(status)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_work_orders_customer ON work_orders(customer_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_work_order_events_order ON work_order_events(work_order_id)

name: ensureAdminSettings
create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_settings (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by TEXT)
